verdict.rationale: Relay's own marketing directly claims automated invoice follow-up ('let Relay handle the follow-up'), and its support docs confirm built-in invoicing with payment collection. However, there is no documentation of how overdue follow-ups work. Recurring invoices are a different capability (one-off vs recurring billing) and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of overdue-specific reminder logic, reminder scheduling/cadence and customization, plan availability, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing

citations.quote: Create invoices, request payments, offer flexible payment options, and let Relay handle the follow-up.
Build and send a branded invoice with built-in payment collection from Invoices — no separate tool needed.
